name: Hot Turkey
review:
A festive roast dinner on Thunderkick's 7x7 cluster engine, with a wild avalanche, exploding wilds and a multiplier grid.

The free spins carry the multiplier grid between spins, which is where the bigger wins come from. Very high volatility, 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.13%, lower than the original Hot Potato, so that's the version to look for if you like the mechanic and want better long-run returns.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
